records.name: IIT Delhi (Biotechnology)
records.description: IIT Delhi's Department of Biochemical Engineering and Biotechnology is a leading department offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs with research strengths in bioprocess engineering, drug discovery, metabolic engineering, and bioinformatics. The department has state-of-the-art fermentation, protein engineering, and analytical laboratories and maintains strong industry partnerships with Indian and multinational biotech companies. IIT Delhi biotech graduates are highly placed in R&D roles in pharmaceuticals, agricultural biotech, and research institutions.

records.name: Wildlife Institute of India
records.description: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) in Dehradun is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, offering postgraduate and doctoral programs in wildlife science, conservation biology, and wildlife management. It provides training to forest officers, wildlife managers, and researchers from India and neighboring countries in ecological surveying, GIS-based habitat modeling, and wildlife forensics. WII conducts nationwide biodiversity assessments and provides scientific advisory support for India's Project Tiger, Project Elephant, and other conservation programs.

records.name: Forest Research Institute (FRI)
records.description: Forest Research Institute (FRI) in Dehradun is one of the oldest and most prestigious forest research institutes in the world, established in 1906, and an autonomous body under the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE). It offers postgraduate and doctoral programs in forestry, wood science, social forestry, and silviculture, and houses India's largest natural history museum dedicated to forest ecosystems. FRI undertakes research in forest conservation, wood utilization, non-timber forest products, and climate change impacts on Indian forests.

records.name: Indian Institute of Forest Management
records.description: Indian Institute of Forest Management (IIFM) in Bhopal is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, offering postgraduate programs in forest management, environmental management, and sustainable development. Its flagship two-year PGDFM (Post Graduate Diploma in Forest Management) is highly regarded by forest departments and environmental organizations. IIFM alumni serve in IFS (Indian Forest Service), corporate sustainability roles, NGOs, and international environmental agencies.

records.name: LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science
records.description: LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science (NICFS) in New Delhi is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Home Affairs, offering postgraduate programs in criminology, forensic science, and police management. It provides specialized training to police officers, judicial officers, and investigators in crime scene investigation, DNA profiling, and forensic psychology. NICFS is the apex training and research institution for forensic and criminological sciences in India.

records.name: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University
records.description: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University (GFSU) in Gandhinagar is the world's first and only exclusive forensic science university, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in forensic science, cyber forensics, behavioral science, and forensic psychology. Established in 2009, it has created a new paradigm in forensic education by integrating science, law, technology, and behavioral studies. GFSU collaborates with Interpol, FBI Academy, and leading international forensic institutions and provides training to police agencies across India.

records.name: CFSL (Central Forensic Science Laboratory)
records.description: Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL) Hyderabad is one of three central government forensic laboratories under the Directorate of Forensic Science Services, Ministry of Home Affairs, providing forensic analysis support to central investigative agencies including CBI, NIA, and SFIO. It offers training programs in forensic biology, document examination, cyber forensics, and forensic toxicology for law enforcement officers and forensic professionals. CFSL Hyderabad is also involved in research and development of new forensic techniques and methodologies.

records.name: Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI)
records.description: Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI) in Mysuru is India's foremost food science and technology research institute, under CSIR, with over 75 years of research in food processing, food safety, and nutrition. It offers postgraduate and doctoral programs through AcSIR and has developed hundreds of food processing technologies that have been transferred to over 3000 industries. CFTRI is internationally recognized for research in functional foods, food packaging, and traditional food product development.

records.name: National Institute of Food Technology (NIFTEM)
records.description: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management (NIFTEM) in Sonipat is a national institute of national importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., MBA, and Ph.D. programs in food technology and food business management. NIFTEM has a unique dual focus on food technology and entrepreneurship, aiming to develop food processing industry leaders and entrepreneurs. It houses state-of-the-art food processing pilot plants and research labs and maintains strong industry linkages with Indian food companies.

records.name: Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI)
records.description: Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) in New Delhi, commonly known as 'Pusa Institute,' is India's national institution for agricultural research and education, under ICAR. It developed the high-yielding wheat and rice varieties that powered India's Green Revolution and offers M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs in agricultural sciences, plant breeding, and agronomy. IARI is among the top agricultural research institutions globally and has produced Nobel Peace Prize-winning researchers including Norman Borlaug's Indian collaborators.
